ground_truth_witness: Use the standard Gray map 0↦00, 1↦01, 2↦11, 3↦10. Let C=⟨(1,1)⟩≤Z₄²={(0,0),(1,1),(2,2),(3,3)}. Its Gray image is {0000,0101,1111,1010}=span_F₂{0101,1010}. These two generators have zero self- and mutual binary dot products, so this dimension-2 code of length 4 is binary self-dual.
ground_truth_flaw: If the Gray image of a linear code over Z/4Z is binary self-dual, then the original quaternary code is self-dual.
